title: Pokwang's '2 Valid IDs' hits P15M box office earnings, eyes Hawaii filmfest

blocks.text: Pokwang‘s award-winning Cinemalaya movie “2 Valid IDs” has earned P15 million in box office sales after it was screened in local cinemas nationwide since October 14, and will now eyeing its international debut at the Hawaii International Film Festival. Unofficial box office estimates placed “2 Valid IDs” on top of the tills with students and families lining the cinemas to witness how a simple identification requirement had affected the life of the main character, Sylvia, played by Pokwang, who used the screen name Marietta Subong.
